_comment: Standard xterm 16-color ANSI palette (RGB). Use as a reference gamut when designing art that must survive a 16-color downgrade, or to map semantic roles onto themeable slots. Indices 0-7 -> SGR 30-37 (fg) / 40-47 (bg); 8-15 -> 90-97 / 100-107. Real values vary by terminal theme -- these are the common xterm defaults. NOTE: there is no orange/brown in this gamut, which is why orange art must target 256/truecolor or a themeable role.
